question.text: Investors should intimate any change in FATCA/CRS related information to the Fund/Manager within:

answer.text: 30 days from the date of knowledge of such change

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 5.20 mandates a 30-day intimation window from the date of knowledge of the change. The Trap: 7/15/60 days are incorrect windows. Cross-Exam Context: Same 30-day rule is reflected in the AML/CFT circulars (XXIV, IFSCA-01). Distributor's Pro-Tip: Annual KYC refresh is a good practice to catch any missed FATCA/CRS changes.
